workload.rateLimit: 10000 per 60s in the harness; deployed demo uses 60 per IP per 60s
workload.coordination: Both gateway Workers reference the same Durable Object namespace on gateway-a
workload.reset: new gateway runtime and temporary SQLite storage per repeat

caveats: Local workerd runtimes on one machine; no WAN or geographic latency.
Controlled fixture outage injected only in this local harness.
Burst baselines run sequentially; steady traffic runs both modes concurrently.
Request coalescing reduces origin work; it does not speed up the first cold origin fetch.
